verses.verse:
वाद्येषु बंशी निगमेषु गीता नदीषु गंगा नगरेषु काशी।
योगेषु भक्तिश्च जनेषु माता हितप्रियाभ्याम् सततं विशिष्टाः।।२।।
verses.text: Among instruments the bānsurī, among scriptures the Gītā, among rivers the Gaṅgā, among cities Kāśī, among yogas devotion, and among people the mother: these always stand out for being both beneficial and dear.

commentary.text: In the world there are only a few things or persons that are dear as well as beneficial. For example: among instruments the bānsurī, which purifies the prāṇa (breath) and sounds sweet to the ears; among scriptures the Gītā, which purifies the mind through yoga and is dear for its simplicity; among rivers the Gaṅgā, which delivers [us] from many diseases and gives creatures sweet and cool water; among cities Kāśī, which frees [us] from many kinds of sin and charms the mind with its beauty; among yogas bhakti (devotion), supremely dear, which removes the darkness of ignorance and lights the lamp of knowledge; and among people the mother, who wishes [our] good and speaks kindly. All these hold a special place in the world.
